name: Futagenesis Unveiled
source:
The story follows Jenny, a futanari, as she grapples with the mystery and consequences of her lifelong secret. Why was she born this way? And what would happen if anyone found out?

[From [url=https://tessaxyz.itch.io/futagenesis-unveiled]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了扶他珍妮努力面对自己终生秘密背后的谜团及其后果。她为何会以这种方式出生？如果有人发现真相，又会发生什么？

[来自[url=https://tessaxyz.itch.io/futagenesis-unveiled]Itch.io[/url]]
